title: What Really Stalked Point Pleasant?

scenes.text: 1970s Point Pleasant reported 12 winged sightings in just 2 years
scenes.query: foggy West Virginia bridge night sky

scenes.text: The first report came on November 15 1970, when two young couples saw a 10‑foot creature with glowing red eyes
Over 400 eyewitnesses described the creature, and a local bridge collapsed the same month, sparking a legend
Scientists now think the sightings were misidentified large owls and a mass‑hysteria wave, but the legend persists
Follow if the unknown keeps you up at night.

description: The Point Pleasant Mothman case sparked a nationwide frenzy. Learn the real facts and why experts lean toward a natural explanation.
